Southern Gas Trading JSC Appoints New Chief Commercial Officer to Support Growth Strategy

Southern Gas Trading JSC, a key player in Malaysia’s oil and gas sector, has announced the appointment of Mr. Adam Rahman as its new Chief Commercial Officer, effective immediately. The move comes as the company seeks to strengthen its commercial operations and expand its market presence across Southeast Asia.

In a statement released on Thursday, Southern Gas Trading JSC highlighted Mr. Rahman’s extensive industry experience, noting his two decades of leadership roles in energy trading and business development. Prior to joining Southern Gas Trading JSC, Mr. Rahman held senior commercial positions at a number of regional energy firms.

“We are delighted to welcome Adam Rahman to our executive team,” said Datin Noraini Che Mat, CEO of Southern Gas Trading JSC. “Adam brings a wealth of experience in commercial strategy and client relationships, which will be instrumental as we pursue new opportunities and reinforce our position in the Malaysian gas market.”

Industry analysts have responded positively to the appointment. “The addition of a seasoned commercial leader like Adam Rahman signals Southern Gas Trading JSC’s commitment to long-term growth and innovation,” said Dr. Surin Lee, Senior Analyst at Southeast Energy Insights, an industry consultancy. “We expect this move to enhance their ability to negotiate supply contracts and streamline trading operations.”

The Malaysian Oil & Gas Producers Association also welcomed the announcement. “Leadership appointments of this calibre are important for the continued competitiveness of Malaysia’s oil and gas sector,” said association spokesperson Farrah Lim. “It’s encouraging to see companies investing in top talent as the market evolves.”

Southern Gas Trading JSC reported steady growth in trading volumes over the past year, driven by rising domestic demand and increased regional partnerships. The company has indicated that strategic leadership appointments will be central to its plans for 2024 and beyond.

Mr. Rahman will be based at the company’s Kuala Lumpur headquarters and is expected to play a key role in Southern Gas Trading JSC’s upcoming commercial initiatives.
